items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Sarah Martin, all those were old blues singers, and they were top record, uh, artists during those years.

ctx.x: Yeah, I hope you have a ton of these. What, uh, kind of recordings did people like down in their 20s? Remember what that was called?

Well, now, I think, uh, a lot of people, they, well, it's, um, now, like blues and some don't, but blues went pretty good during the 20s, you know? Because, just like the records they made, now, Bessie Smith and Mamie Smith, uh, Trixie, uh, Chippy Hill, and, uh, Sarah Martin, all those were old blues singers, and they were top record, uh, artists during those years. So, they must have undoubtedly liked blues during that time, see? Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Because, I, I kind of think they, they like, they like, as far as…
Yeah, but, uh, the men weren't doing much record making during that time. Mm-hmm.
